     1	import dlt
     2	from pyspark.sql.functions import col, current_timestamp
     3	from pyspark.sql.types import *
     4	from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
     5	
     6	spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()
     7	catalog = spark.conf.get("catalog")
     8	pipeline_schema = spark.conf.get("pipeline_schema")
     9	volume = spark.conf.get("volume")
    10	file_path = f"/Volumes/{catalog}/{pipeline_schema}/{volume}/consumer/"
    11	
    12	# Explicit schema from metadata_consumer.json
    13	schema = StructType([
    14	    StructField("consumer_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    15	    StructField("name", StringType(), nullable=True),
    16	    StructField("age", IntegerType(), nullable=True),
    17	    StructField("gender", StringType(), nullable=True),
    18	    StructField("email", StringType(), nullable=True),
    19	    StructField("phone", StringType(), nullable=True),
    20	    StructField("address", StringType(), nullable=True),
    21	    StructField("city", StringType(), nullable=True),
    22	    StructField("state", StringType(), nullable=True),
    23	    StructField("country", StringType(), nullable=True),
    24	    StructField("registration_date", StringType(), nullable=True),
    25	    StructField("is_active", BooleanType(), nullable=True),
    26	    StructField("operation", StringType(), nullable=False)
    27	])
    28	
    29	@dlt.view(name="raw_consumer")
    30	def raw_consumer():
    31	    df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles") \
    32	        .option("cloudFiles.format", "json") \
    33	        .option("multiline", "true") \
    34	        .schema(schema) \
    35	        .load(file_path)
    36	    return df.withColumn("ingestion_time", current_timestamp())
    37	
    38	dlt.create_streaming_table("consumer_cdc_stream")
    39	
    40	dlt.apply_changes(
    41	    target="consumer_cdc_stream",
    42	    source=dlt.read("raw_consumer"),
    43	    keys=["consumer_id"],
    44	    sequence_by=col("ingestion_time"),
    45	    apply_as_deletes=col("operation") == "delete",
    46	    except_column_list=["operation", "ingestion_time"],
    47	    stored_as_scd_type=2
    48	)
